summary: SPK RC 46 giao dien Nocturne moi + bo cong cu chu thich day du (chon/di chuyen, but da quang, ellipse, tay, do day net, undo/redo).
changes: Doi toan bo bang mau sang Nocturne: nen tim than (--co-bg #161826, --co-panel #1e2030), them token rieng --co-stage cho khung video, accent chuyen tu #6c5cf6 sang #9184d9 tren toan he thong.
Bo cong tac 'Bat che do chu thich': lop ve luon san sang, cong cu mac dinh la Chon; click vao vung trong khung hinh van play/pause nhu cu.
Them 4 cong cu moi: Chon/di chuyen (V), But da quang (H), Khoanh tron (O), Tay (E) — cong voi But ve (P), Mui ten (A), Khung (R), Text (T).
Them do day net (3 muc) va cho phep doi mau/do day cua net da ve bang cach chon net do truoc.
Them undo/redo (Cmd+Z / Shift+Cmd+Z) va Delete de xoa net dang chon; thanh cong cu tach thanh 2 hang tren-duoi khung hinh.
Sua loi lop SVG chu thich bi vuong 1:1 thay vi phu kin khung hinh — truoc day net ve bi lech so voi vi tri chuot.
Backend validateAnnotation nhan them tool ellipse/highlight va luu do day net (clamp 1..24); tach ra apps/api/src/annotation.js kem test rieng.
Man hinh review co them the version va avatar nguoi dang xem cung (truoc day chi hien o topBar, khong hien trong review).
